purpose: UTF-8 literals with diacritics and an em dash, plus the equivalent TeX accent commands and ---.
flashtex_features: accent commands (currently rendered as separate glyphs)
notes: Literal and command forms should be visually identical in a real TeX; the second half measures FlashTeX's accent-command gap.
page_size: US letter 612x792pt (geometry default paper for article is letterpaper)
preamble_policy: engine-specific apples-to-apples preamble is substituted by the harness; FlashTeX gets the body only
